## Evidencia
Runs: `npm test` (489 pass, 0 fail) and `npm run test:mods` (all 8 mods pass; `marchas`: `42 pass, 0 fail`). RED before the change: rules 1-5, 7 and 8 failed with `Received: []`; rule 6 and both preserve tests passed. `claude plugin validate mods/marchas`: `✔ Validation passed with warnings` (the existing missing-author warning).

The rule tests load a stand-in `modo-autonomo` as an inline plugin beside the gear mod (`test(name, { plugins: [...] }, body)`): a test cannot import another plugin's folder. Like `mods/modo-autonomo/hooks/register.ts`, the stand-in answers `/autonomo` itself and writes its own `isOn`. Each test asserts the exact list of notices, so "shows its warning once" and "no warning outside these cases" are checked by the same assertion. The existing 32 `marchas` tests still pass.

Not verified live: how the notice looks in an interactive terminal; the harness only proves it is appended.
